d:
A sister struggles.
Miranda lives in a desolate, remote rural area, taking care of her distant, odd brother Billy in their isolated home. It is a lonely life, and Miranda struggles, especially as Billy retreats further into his shell.
But as strange occurrences unfold around them, Billy becomes fixated, and his behavior becomes more erratic. Miranda struggles with her need to move forward and her obligations to protect her troubled brother, as certain incidents grow in ominous portent and intensity.
